metadata.display_name: Enhanced Built-up and Bare Land Index
metadata.description: Simultaneously identifies built-up and bare land features by integrating shortwave infrared, near-infrared, and thermal infrared emissive contrast.
metadata.scientific_reference: As-syakur, A. R., Adnyana, I. W. S., Arthana, I. W., & Nuarsa, I. W. (2012). Enhanced Built-Up and Bareness Index (EBBI) for Mapping Built-Up and Bare Land in an Urban Area. Remote Sensing, 4(10), 2957-2970.
